text: Every planning lesson points here: Marcus opens a real Terraform project and provisions the AWS infrastructure this whole implementation runs on.
A VPC with public and private subnets across three Availability Zones -- the database and worker nodes stay off the public internet by construction.
The haverbrook-tickets EKS cluster goes on top, with a managed node group sized as a real starting point.
Two ECR repositories, one per service, plus an RDS Postgres instance reachable only from the EKS node security group.
Next: containerizing catalog-api and checkout-api so there's finally something real to deploy onto this infrastructure.
